greeting: Welcome back to Release Radar, where we track the WordPress plugin universe so you don't have to!
introParagraph: This week, the plugin landscape was a vibrant mix of accessibility enhancements, crucial bug fixes, and some genuinely exciting new features. We saw a strong push towards making feeds more inclusive, a few 'oopsie' moments in core editor functionality getting patched, and some clever additions to form and event management. It seems developers are not just patching holes, but also paving new, more accessible roads.

highlights.title: Sugar Calendar Lite 3.13.0
highlights.summary: This release introduces a brand-new Registration Form feature, allowing you to collect extra attendee details like meal choices or company names during ticket checkout or RSVP registration. It's a sweet addition for event organizers looking to streamline their data collection.

highlights.title: WPForms Lite 2.0.1.1
highlights.summary: WPForms is stepping up its game with a new QR Code setting for easy page sharing and an 'Add Media' button in the Confirmation Message editor. These small but mighty additions enhance user experience and form flexibility.

highlights.title: All in One SEO 5.0.1.1
highlights.summary: A critical fix here, as the link toolbar's nofollow, sponsored, and UGC options were playing hide-and-seek in the editor. This update ensures your SEO attributes are back where they belong, preventing any accidental "follow" faux pas.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Instagram Feed 6.12.0
highlights.summary: Smash Balloon continues its accessibility drive, making the Instagram feed builder and your feeds significantly easier to use for keyboard and screen reader users. This commitment to inclusivity is a big win for everyone.

highlights.title: PushEngage 4.2.9
highlights.summary: PushEngage launches a new 'Tools' page to explore its AI toolkit, including WordPress Abilities and the MCP Adapter plugin, complete with live status detection. It's a glimpse into the future of intelligent marketing automation for your WordPress site.
